game.name: Motogp '07 (USA, Europe)
game.desc: MotoGP '07 for Xbox 360 is, as the name suggests, a motorbike racing simulation. Join the real 850cc riders from 2007 and race on all the championship tracks. Experience a full extreme mode with 17 recreated and expanded tracks to take advantage of the 20 new customisable bikes. Compete against 15 other players online in new game modes and tournaments. You can even put your bike on the line to win someone else's!
